description: Registry for reviewed Quran word-by-word annotations. No annotations are published until provenance and permission are verified.

requirements.wordIndex: 1-based index of whitespace-delimited display token; not a morphological segment
requirements.arabicToken: exact Unicode token matching Quran edition
requirements.meaningRu: reviewed Russian word meaning, not full-ayah translation
requirements.readingRu: optional, reviewed learning aid; never a substitute for tajwid
